custodyRules: No credential values, passphrases, private keys, raw environment files, login caches or temporary download bearer URLs in this packet or repository.
Owner retains account access, secret custody and decryption passphrase; agent prepares technical artifacts and reads sanitized receipts.
Runtime provider secrets remain backend-only; Android signing secrets remain in approved signing storage; encrypted Drive archives do not replace runtime secret storage.
Keep Singapore and legacy project records separate; verify target/ref/role before using a credential.
Keep passphrase separate from Drive archive. Upload ciphertext and sanitized manifest/checksum only, verify private parent and owner-only metadata without changing sharing.
Do not re-run completed key recovery drills merely to fill a packet; new or changed credentials need their own backup and restore proof.
Do not repeat the completed 674-history scan or ask Owner to paste unknown original keys into chat.
Creation, backup, activation, route/content publication, deployment, production promotion and store publication are distinct decisions and evidence states.
